'''Ruusan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] most famous for the [[Ruusan campaign]], the last stand of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] under Lord [[Skere Kaan|Kaan]] and the birthplace of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane's]] [[Order of the Sith Lords]]. The planet lent its name to the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] enacted after the battle.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Ruusan_with_the_Three_Sisters.png|thumb|left|200px|Planet Ruusan with the Three Sisters.]]
Ruusan was originally a [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]], pleasant world with rivers and forests.<ref name="TEA" /> Its atmosphere and gravity were compatible with Class Three planets.<ref name="DF:JK">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref> It was inhabited by [[Ruusanian/Legends|Ruusanians]], Humans, and a strange [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species known as [[Bouncer]]s.
Fauna included some [[Insect/Legends|insects]] and other bugs.<ref name="DF:RA" />

The underground was rich in [[cesium]], [[copper/Legends|copper]], [[Iridium_(element)/Legends|iridium]], [[iron/Legends|iron]], [[nickel]], [[Uranium/Legends|uranium]] and many other [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] deposits; in ancient times there was [[mining/Legends|mining]] activity.<ref name="DF:JK" />
Ruusan's [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] deposits proved disappointing but it was the only source for the [[Ruusan crystal]].

Ruusan had three [[Moon/Legends|moons]], referred to by locals as the "Three Sisters." [[Smuggler/Legends|Smugglers]] claimed that at least one of the moons had ruins of an ancient civilization.<ref name="DF:JK" />

Vegetation included some low-growing bushes with some scent; they had the potential to provide aromatic oils although nobody cared to enter this procedure. [[Lichen/Legends|Lichen]] could grow on some rocks.<ref name="DF:RA" />

In the mornings, the planet's landscape was painted in lavender and gold colors by the light of its rising sun.<ref name="DF:RA" />

Astrographically, Ruusan belonged to one of the relatively young star systems of the Teraab sector, usually rich in [[metal/Legends|metal]]; however Ruusan was not only at the edge of the sector, among other newborn stars and [[nebula/Legends|nebulae]], but also proved to be poorer than other planets in nearby systems.<ref name="wizards" />

==History==
The planet was first colonized between [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]] to [[8000 BBY]], sometime between the [[Kymoodon Era]] and [[Rianitus Period]].<ref name="TEA" />

While meeting with his ally [[Webb]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[3643 BBY]], [[Andronikos Revel]] remarked that if [[Exchange]] officer [[Sylas Wilkes]], Revel's [[Mutiny|mutinous]] former [[First Mate/Legends|first mate]] whom he was on-planet to kill, found out he was there, ''"it'll be like Ruusan all over again"'', suggesting some kind of conflict had taken place there between himself and the Exchange by then.<ref name="Pirate & Girl">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|The Pirate and the Girl|Tatooine}}</ref>

In [[2200 BBY/Legends|2200 BBY]] Ruusan was one of the ore-rich planets of the [[Teraab sector/Legends|Teraab sector]] claimed by the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]], until the planet proved disappointing.<ref name="wizards" /> Owing to its distant astrographic location, focus shifted to richer worlds nearby, leaving a few settlements of few optimistic claim jumpers, fugitives, miners, farmers, and trappers by the end of the [[Light and Darkness War]], who would be the ancestors of [[Ruusanian/Legends|Ruusanians]].<ref name="wizards" /><ref name="TEA" /> All in all, Ruusan had at least seven mines, which by the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]] they all had been exploited and abandoned.<ref name="DF:JK" />

[[File:Ruusan_surface.jpg|left|150px|The surface of Ruusan.]]
Ruusan was the site of seven battles between the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] and the Jedi's [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]]. After the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|last battle of Ruusan]] ([[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]) between the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] under [[Jedi Lord|Lord]] [[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Hoth]], and the Sith under [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord]] [[Skere Kaan]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] resolved to annihilate everyone, including himself, with a [[thought bomb]]. Much of the planet's surface, including vegetation and several cities, were destroyed, and remained a barren desert.<ref name="wizards" />

After the battle had ended, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Johun Othone]] petitioned the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to construct a grand mausoleum containing the fallen warriors in the site of the massacre, called The [[Valley of the Jedi]].<ref name="wizards" />

[[File:Yoda-like_Ruusan.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The [[Valley of the Jedi]].]]
Despite this, the expanding [[Nebula/Legends|nebulae]] of the sector erased the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] connecting Ruusan<ref name="TEA" /> and the world was quickly forgotten, as the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] turned inward. Isolation and crossbreeding amongst the inhabitants produced a [[near-Human]] population that became known as [[Ruusanian/Legends|Ruusanians]]. Shifting [[Nebula/Legends|nebulae]] within the stellar nursery of the Teraab soon erased hyperspace routes to Ruusan, leaving it inaccessible from the galaxy at large. Only the Mining Guild and, for different reasons, the Jedi Order, remembered Ruusan's history. Even those who heard about the Valley of the Jedi, like [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] or [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]], did not know its location.<ref name="wizards" />

===Reemergence===
The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] briefly established a [[Skytop Station/Legends|spy post]] over [[Ruusan 2/Legends|one of Ruusan's moons]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], but it was soon [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|destroyed]].<ref name="TEA" /> By the [[Imperial Era/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] reign, Ruusan was mostly forgotten.

Rediscovered by the smuggler [[Jerg]] in [[11 BBY/Legends|11 BBY]], the planet came to be used by independent spacers and merchants, and fugitives of the sector, as a base of operations.<ref name="DF:RA" /><ref name="wizards" /> The [[10 BBY/Legends|next year]], [[Fort Nowhere]] was constructed by smugglers.<ref name="TEA" /> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] refugees from [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]] settled on the planet, following Jerg and [[Morgan Katarn]].<ref name="DF:RA" /> The following years the colonists survived with [[cave farming]] and grazing animals such as [[gra]]. Although some of them exited to the badlands for grazing, it was too harsh to bother with exploration, and only the most curious ones had minimal contact with the native Bouncers.<ref name="JKaudio">[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Jedi Knight'' audio drama]]</ref>

[[File:Jerec_Sariss_Ruusan.jpg|thumb|150px|[[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] and [[Sariss]] on board the ''[[Vengeance (Vengeance-class)|Vengeance]]'' above Ruusan, over a [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]] of the planet.]]
The planet's isolation would end shortly after the Battle of Endor. The Dark Jedi [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]], informed of the location of the [[Valley of the Jedi]], came to the planet intending to claim the Valley's power for himself.<ref name="DF:RA" /> His [[Vengeance Battle Group]] performed surveys on the planet with [[probe droid/Legends|probe droids]]; the operation necessitated the [[Battle of Fort Nowhere|extermination of the smuggler colony]]. During the second phase of the survey, a tower was being built, and the Imperials looted the caves around the Valley for valuable artifacts in order to satisfy the Remnant and its nitpickers financially; an "archaeological work" which stirred up the spirits.<ref name="DF:JK" />

At the end of that phase, Jerec himself arrived to the planet.<ref name="DF:JK" /> The Jedi [[Kyle Katarn]], assisted by the spirit of [[Qu Rahn/Legends|Qu Rahn]], managed to stop Jerec, slaying the Dark Jedi below the monuments that Othone had built centuries ago.<ref name="DF:JK" />

After being beaten by a different dark jedi named [[Desann]], Katarn would return to Ruusan in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] to reestablish his connection to the Force, during the confrontation of the [[Empire Reborn]], and in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], during the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] crisis to [[Mission to the Valley of the Jedi|investigate]] the Valley of the Jedi for cult activity.<ref name="JKA">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>

The world was later targeted by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], who successfully invaded and occupied the planet over a year into their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the galaxy. It would remain under Vong control until the end of the war.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Jedi_Temple_stained_glass_concept_art.png|thumb|right|250px|Jedi Temple stained glass concept art in ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two'']]
Ruusan appeared in the artwork by [[Wayne Lo]] titled "Unused Jedi Temple mosaic" for the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. It was included in the production journal of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two]]''. The concept art also depicted [[Valenthyne Farfalla]] leading the Army of Light, Lord Hoth and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Pernicar]].<ref name="TCW CS2">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]]</ref> Parts of the mosaic can be seen, which includes Ruusan, in a [[Unidentified veranda (Jedi Temple)|room]] in "[[Lightsaber Lost]]," the eleventh episode of the second season of the series.<ref name="LL">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref>
